key_highlights: ASX set for steep declines following Wall Street's tumble into correction territory driven by an AI tech selloff, compounding last week's $169 billion market loss.
Australian Flash PMI plunged into recessionary territory, heightening market debate over whether RBA overtightening is crushing economic growth.
Severe household pressure mounts as five rate hikes erode borrowing power, triggering sharp declines in Sydney dwelling values and retail distress evidenced by 1,700 job cuts at David Jones.
AUD/USD remains under acute downward pressure amid global risk-off contagion and domestic macroeconomic vulnerability, providing a mixed tailwind for export-focused miners.

sectors.trend: Severe margin pressure and asset quality concerns as cumulative RBA rate hikes severely curtail household borrowing power and depress property values.
sectors.implications: Major banks face headwinds from slowing mortgage credit growth, rising provisions, and heightened competition for deposits.

sectors.trend: Bifurcation between gold exploration/restarts outperforming as defensive safe havens and broad base metals facing macro demand headwinds.
sectors.implications: Capital raising interest concentrates in gold producers and critical minerals breakthroughs, while a weak AUD supports unhedged commodity revenues.

sectors.trend: Acute valuation derating in sympathy with Wall Street's AI stock selloff and global tech correction.
sectors.implications: ASX tech leaders face significant multiple compression; companies exposed to corporate hiring freezes and AI disruption face decelerating growth.

sectors.trend: Accelerating distress in discretionary spending reflected in major restructuring and 1,700 job cuts at David Jones.
sectors.implications: Consumer retrenchment favours discount and value-oriented retailers (e.g. Myer poaching market share) while discretionary operators face margin contraction.

sectors.trend: Structural policy headwind from the Federal Government's PBS price freeze extension to 2030, alongside dietary shifts driven by GLP-1 weight-loss drugs.
sectors.implications: Pharmaceutical margins capped under PBS constraints; consumer food producers reassess product portfolios, while select biotechs show idiosyncratic momentum.

sectors.trend: Aggressive downward pressure on residential and commercial asset valuations as Sydney housing prices tumble rapidly.
sectors.implications: Property trusts face cap rate expansion, lower transaction volumes, and balance sheet revaluation risks.

sectors.trend: Scrutiny on domestic energy transition infrastructure viability, capital costs (Snowy Hydro 2.0), and fossil fuel import dependencies.
sectors.implications: Capital allocation scrutiny increases for large-scale energy projects; traditional producers benefit from energy security focus.

key_themes: Global Equity De-risking: Wall Street AI correction spilling into the ASX after $169B was wiped off the local bourse.
RBA Policy Overtightening: Flash PMI in recession territory and housing price declines reigniting fears that rate hikes have broken consumer resilience.
Defensive Rotation: Capital flight towards gold assets and domestic defensive earners amidst AUD weakness and equity volatility.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight cyclical equities, discretionary retail, and rate-sensitive banks; increase allocation to cash and short-duration sovereign paper.
Reduce exposure to high-multiple tech names (WTC.AX, XRO.AX) and hedge via index put options (^AXJO).

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing Market Wealth Shock & Credit Deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Trim exposure to residential developers and retail banks with high exposure to leveraged mortgage books.
Position in USD-earning resource majors (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) and unhedged offshore earnings streams.

opportunities.rationale: Gold equities provide defensive hedging and margin expansion supported by depressed AUD/USD and market volatility.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective Exposure to Department Store Consolidation Winners
opportunities.rationale: Myer is capitalising on David Jones' retrenchment and store downsizing by capturing supplier agreements and customer footfall.
BHP and Rio Tinto benefit from a weaker AUD lowering local production costs while maintaining robust balance sheets.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge Broad Market Exposure via Index Short / Put Options
defensive_moves.rationale: Protect portfolio capital against contagion from Wall Street correction following a $169B weekly loss.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight High-Multiple Tech and Discretionary Retail
defensive_moves.rationale: AI sentiment unwinding and consumer wallet contraction create negative earnings revision risk.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce Exposure to Major Mortgage Lenders
defensive_moves.rationale: Borrowing capacity collapse and accelerating residential real estate price falls increase credit risk and compress lending volume.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish over 1–3 months as the ASX 200 absorbs Wall Street correction spillovers, local recessionary flash PMIs, and deteriorating housing sentiment.
market_outlook.long_term: Neutral over 6–12 months, contingent on RBA easing policy to stabilise household balance sheets and a cyclical recovery in Chinese commodity demand.

Wall Street tech earnings and AI capex trajectory

Domestic employment and monthly housing credit data
